claim: SDF-CVF solves the drift problem where code, documentation, tests, and execution traces evolve independently, leading to inconsistent systems. SDF-CVF enforces quartet invariant (Code, docs, tests, traces MUST evolve together atomically) with parity score (P) ≥ 0.90 required for all changes.

SDF-CVF provides five core guarantees: quartet invariant (code/docs/tests/traces evolve together), parity enforcement (P ≥ 0.90), automated gates (pre-commit, CI, deployment gates block low-parity changes), blast radius calculation (predict change impact), and DORA metrics (track deployment quality).
SDF-CVF quartet detection identifies code, docs, tests, and traces related to a change, extracts quartet elements from Git diffs and file changes, and validates completeness (all 4 elements present).

SDF-CVF parity calculation embeds all quartet elements (code, docs, tests, traces), calculates 6 pairwise similarities (code↔docs, code↔tests, code↔traces, docs↔tests, docs↔traces, tests↔traces), computes average parity score P = avg(all similarities) with target P ≥ 0.90 for acceptance.

SDF-CVF gate system includes pre-commit gate (check parity before merge), CI gate (validate parity in continuous integration pipeline), deployment gate (verify parity before production deployment), with action P ≥ 0.90 → PASS, P < 0.90 → FAIL (quarantine).

SDF-CVF blast radius calculator analyzes change impact (files affected, dependencies), finds dependent files (via imports, references), identifies documentation mentioning changed code, finds tests covering changed components, detects traces involving changed components, and estimates total affected files for effort planning.

SDF-CVF auto-remediation system suggests fixes for low-parity changes, identifies missing quartet elements (docs, tests, traces), generates remediation tasks (add docs, write tests, record traces), and provides examples and templates for fixes.

SDF-CVF DORA metrics tracker measures deployment frequency (how often we ship), lead time for changes (commit → production time), time to restore service (incident → resolution), and change failure rate (% of changes causing incidents).
SDF-CVF consists of five core components: Quartet Detector, Parity Calculator, Gate Manager, Blast Radius Calculator, and DORA Metrics Tracker.

SDF-CVF uses quartet invariant (code/docs/tests/traces evolve together), parity enforcement (P ≥ 0.90), automated gates (pre-commit/CI/deployment), blast radius calculation (predict impact), and DORA metrics (track quality).

SDF-CVF real-world workflows include quartet parity validation (detect quartet, calculate parity, gate decision), blast radius analysis (analyze impact, find dependencies, estimate effort), and DORA metrics tracking (track deployments, calculate metrics, analyze trends).

SDF-CVF operational runbook includes pre-commit quality gate (detect quartet, calculate parity, check threshold, gate decision, remediation), daily checklist (run autonomous checklist, review dashboard, update remediation log), and release checklist (freeze writes, run CVF suite, verify parity, monitor metrics).
SDF-CVF performance characteristics: quartet detection (~50ms), parity calculation (~200ms), gate evaluation (~10ms), blast radius calculation (~100ms).

SDF-CVF four interlocking loops: Author loop (writers run local gates before pushing), Ops loop (automated agents execute checklists on timers), Review loop (humans inspect dashboards and deviations), Learning loop (results feed back into templates and prompts).

SDF-CVF quartet parity framework measures alignment across Code, Docs, Tests, and Tags with parity score P ≥ 0.90 required for quality gates. Parity calculated using code-doc similarity, test coverage, and trace completeness.
